content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the incorrect handling of the OP-TEE node and its reserved memory region in the device tree for STM32MP15 boards. The OP-TEE node was added with a status of "disabled," which led U-Boot to assume that the kernel device tree was correct for OP-TEE usage. However, since the reserved memory region for OP-TEE was not declared, the kernel mistakenly treated that memory as free, leading to conflicts when the kernel attempted to access the CMA region, which was already in use by OP-TEE. This resulted in errors raised by OP-TEE when the kernel accessed the memory. The fix involved moving the OP-TEE and SCMI nodes to a dedicated file to ensure proper memory reservation and usage.
